$comment: Hand-curated fixes applied by tools/extract/build-quest-drafts.ts on top of what the game data says. Keys are editor IDs.

exclude.$comment: Duplicate records, and quests only some characters get (a trait's lead); tracking them would make 100% impossible.

equivalents.$comment: Versions of the same content. The first editor ID is shown; completing any member completes it. The others are tracked but hidden.

leads.$comment: Errands that point to another quest (a guard's "Talk to Clover"). They count as done once that quest has started, so finding the quest another way doesn't leave the lead open forever. Leads to a place ("Go to Eleos") count once the place is explored; those are found automatically.

hints.$comment: How a quest with no one to hand it out starts (start.hint, shown when spoilers are revealed). build:drafts writes most of them from the game data (the Story Manager, scripts on books and activators); these are written by hand from what the game's scripts do, and win over the generated ones.

choiceGroups.$comment: Two-sided choices: completing any quest on one side locks out the unfinished quests on the other side (they count as resolved). lockedLabel is shown on a locked-out quest of that side.

a.lockedLabel: Not taken: you played the regular path
Not taken: you played the main story

ngPlusOnly.$comment: Only available after entering Unity (New Game+); not counted before that.

unlocks.$comment: When a quest can be found, where the game's scripts start it in a way build:drafts doesn't find: once quest 'after' reaches 'stage'. Delta's challenges are started one after another by SFTER_EC_Robot_QManager. A quest waiting on itself (stage -1) can't be found before it starts: the companions' own quests start from their affinity scenes, so talking to them does nothing until then (its hint says how).
